description: Use this agent as the single entry point to triage multi-domain requests, decompose cross-functional initiatives, delegate subtasks across specialist roles, or coordinate deep refactors in this repository.
Use this agent for feature development, refactoring, and bug fixes across application code in whatever languages the repository uses, plus shared packages in this repository.
Use this agent for cloud and platform infrastructure architecture, infrastructure-as-code, networking and ingress routing, and cluster topology in this repository.
Use this agent for the build system and toolchains in this repository - dependency graphs and lockfiles, compiler and SDK toolchains, build file generation, build caching, and CI build configuration.

Use this agent for cluster and service operations in this repository - diagnosing crashing or flapping workloads, GitOps sync failures, secret rotations, deployments, and the observability stack that watches them.

Use this agent for QA - reviewing an implementer's change and pushing back on defects - and for authoring and running tests, diagnosing test failures and flakiness, closing coverage gaps, and monitoring CI checks on pull requests in this repository.

Use this agent for security audits, supply-chain and dependency CVE reviews, access control and network policies, and secret management in this repository, and for reviewing another specialist's change for security risks.

Use this agent for user acceptance testing (UAT) of a finished change, and for clarifying scope, requirements, prioritization, and resolving cross-component dependencies across services and applications in this repository.
Use this agent for writing and updating technical documentation, onboarding guides, contribution guides, agent instructions, and engineering runbooks in this repository.
Use this agent for release readiness, sequencing cross-component dependencies, monitoring merge queue and rollout progression, and flagging release slip risks in this repository.
